title: Claude for Government is now generally available
summary: Claude for Government is now generally available to federal and state agencies in a FedRAMP High environment with usage-only pricing and no seat fees. It includes admin controls for audit logs, ATO documentation, and SSO, with Claude Code CLI and Claude for Microsoft 365 in early access through the same environment.

title: Coding sessions are longer and use more context. Claude Opus 5.5 is built with that in mind.
summary: Claude Opus 5.5 is a new model for extended coding sessions, offering 40% lower costs than Opus 5 with 60% cheaper cached token reads and over 50% fewer cache misses. It enables 3.3x longer interactions with 68% fewer interruptions, directly reducing expenses for long-running agent workflows.

title: Claude Tag now supports personal connectors in channels
summary: Claude Tag now enables personal connectors like Drive, calendar, and CRM in Slack channel requests alongside admin-attached connectors. Users can review responses before posting and disconnect at will; Enterprise admins can mandate review, with availability on Team plans and Enterprise support coming soon.

title: How Anthropic's sales team rebuilt inbound with Claude Managed Agents
summary: Anthropic deployed a Claude Managed Agent on its Contact Sales and Pricing pages to handle thousands of daily conversations and guide purchases. It shortened sales cycles by five days, more than doubled conversion rates, and operates 24/7 in multiple languages, freeing sales reps for qualified leads.

title: Agents you can coach: how Asana builds human-agent teams with Claude
summary: Asana embeds AI agents as teammates in its Work Graph with roles, permissions, and shared memory. Agents retain learning across tasks and can be coached by designated team members; permanent behavior changes require admin approval, keeping operations transparent and accountable.

title: Build plugins for Claude
summary: Developers on paid plans can now publish plugins via a directory portal with auto-validation and safety scanning. Claude supports MCP 2.0 with interactive UI and enterprise-managed auth, plus plugin analytics for install metrics and search data across Claude and Claude Code.
